info.name: Dropbox Lite - Upload Service
info.description:
Direct-to-service requests for upload-service (bypasses the API Gateway). Auth is simulated via the X-User-Id header, matching CurrentUserHeaderFilter which normally trusts a header set by the gateway after JWT validation. Uses the same fixed dev-seed test user UUID as the metadata-service collection so folderId validation (which calls metadata-service) works against seeded data.

Workflow: run 'Initiate Upload' first (auto-captures uploadId into the collection variable), then 'Upload Part' once per part, then 'Get Upload Status' to check progress/resume, then 'Complete Upload'.

variable.description: Fixed dev-seed test user UUID (see metadata-service DevDataSeeder)
Optional. Set any string to test idempotent replay of Initiate Upload.
Optional. Set to a seeded folder id to test folder validation; leave blank for a root-level upload.
Auto-filled from the Initiate Upload response.

request.description: chunkSize/totalParts are server-selected. For a small test file under 8MiB, totalParts will always be 1, and the single part's expected size equals 'size' exactly - the byte count you PUT for part 1 must match 'size' precisely (MinIO rejects a short/long stream against a declared size). To test folder validation, replace the body's "folderId": null with "folderId": "{{folderId}}" and set the folderId collection variable to a real, seeded folder id.

Raw binary/text body, streamed directly - not @RequestBody, no multipart/form-data. The default body here is exactly 20 bytes to match the default Initiate Upload 'size' of 20. If you change one, change the other to match. To upload a real binary file instead, switch Body mode to 'binary' and select a file, and set 'size' in Initiate Upload to that file's exact byte length.
Returns status, totalParts, and uploadedParts - compare against 1..totalParts to see what's still missing (resume).

Composes all parts in MinIO, then materializes the file/version in metadata-service (direct service-to-service call). Safe to call repeatedly - already-COMPLETED replays, STORAGE_COMPLETED resumes without recomposing.
